test_return_cpp_polymorphism: test that a C++ created B object returns B::f() when calling method f through Python
test_references_exposed_types: test that unexposed C++ class B returns type A while exposed class C returns type C
test_factory_polymorphic_return: test the factory function returns correct polymorphic types A or C based on integer argument
test_python_override_virtual: test that a Python subclass X of C++ class A correctly overrides virtual method f
test_pure_virtual_override: test that pure virtual method raises RuntimeError on base P but works on Python subclass R
